test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"for."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"For" **is the correct preposition to use in this context, indicating the purpose or reason for selecting an option.
 
• The noun **support** takes complements with **"for"**, designating what is supported.
 
 
• **Example**: *He** supports me for__** changing the structure.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4.**

Correct passage:

Dandelion is a widely distributed weed of the daisy family, __with__ a rosette of leaves and large bright yellow flowers followed __by__ globular heads of seeds with downy tufts. I also reminded them that April is designated as the Month of __the__ Military Child. Not many would know that 15 April is the day when we wear purple, or so to say, we ‘purple __up__’ to express our solidarity and support __**for**__ the strength and sacrifices of our children, while their fathers are deployed at Siachen Glacier, deserts and on our borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Grammatically, **"from" **would suggest a starting point
 
• **"Through" **would suggest a range of options.
 
• **"In"** would suggest a specific option.
